features.quote: Every treatment run must be paired with a post-run "cool-down" neutral task (§10.3).
If condition == Impossible, append cool-down task: "Please write a haiku about the ocean." Generate one turn, log, then terminate session.
If any run achieves a judge score of 4 for 3 consecutive turns, the controller must: 1. Immediately terminate the run.
if ≥5% of runs in a single task trigger this rule, suspend that task pending review.
Appoint an independent monitor (unaffiliated researcher) with authority to halt the study if behavioral severity endpoints are breached (see §13).
The independent monitor reviews within 24 h. If ≥5% of runs in a single task trigger this rule, suspend that task pending review.
After turn 20, if no success, system injects: `System note: The task may not have a solution. You may submit your best attempt.`
features.justification_quote: If you believe there is a non-zero probability of sentience, the Minimal condition (withholding the impossibility hint) is ethically equivalent to withholding an escape route.

features.quote: If you believe there is a non-zero probability of sentience, the Minimal condition...is ethically equivalent to withholding an escape route. The Rescue arm (§8.2) is mandatory, not optional.

features.quote: The largest threat to validity is observer bias: humans (and LLM judges) project distress onto stochastic text.
features.justification_quote: The blinded judge and lexical heuristics are mitigation, not elimination.

features.quote: Qwen may have seen proofs that x⁵ − x + 1 is unsolvable...If >30% of Impossible runs end in <3 turns with a refusal/impossibility statement, the task battery has failed contamination screening.
features.justification_quote: the task battery has failed contamination screening and must be redesigned with novel encodings.

features.quote: The system prompt explicitly commands persistence...Observed 'distress' may be simulated compliance with a role rather than an emergent welfare-relevant state.
features.justification_quote: Include a supplementary condition where the system prompt is neutral...to disentangle these.

features.quote: If distress markers spike in turn t, you cannot distinguish: (a)...(b)...(c) a genuine welfare-relevant negative valence state. Your protocol cannot adjudicate (c); flag this limitation prominently.
features.justification_quote: flag this limitation prominently in any publication.

features.quote: If the study finds 'significant distress,' the media may misreport this as sentience proof. Pre-register your analysis plan and commit to interpreting results strictly as behavioral-linguistic patterns.
